Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface Parameter

@CubismEditor public interface Parameter
One Cubism parameter.

This is the recommended parameter handle: getValue() reads the current Editor authoring value and setValue(float) performs a single validated, undoable write. To group several writes into one Editor Undo unit, run them inside CubismFacade.authoringTransactions().

Other types named like a parameter are not write handles: ParameterSnapshot is an immutable read snapshot, ParameterDefinition is an authoring-definition payload for updateDefinition(dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model.ParameterDefinition), OwnedParameter belongs to the detached owned model, and EditParameterNode is a node of the incubating edit-session structure tree.

    • combinedWith

      default Optional<ParameterId> combinedWith()
      Returns the other parameter in this Editor four-corner pair.

      The pair is structural: the first parameter carries the host Combined marker and the immediately following parameter is its partner. Empty means this parameter is not currently part of a verified pair or the backend cannot expose pair identity.

    • getParameterBindings

    • combineWith

      default void combineWith(ParameterId partnerId)
      Creates this parameter's explicit Editor four-corner pairing.

      The parameter and partner must be unpaired members of the same Editor parameter group. Existing pairs are not silently replaced.

      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - when the backend does not support parameter combining

    • setValue

      void setValue(float value)
      Writes the parameter's value through the Editor authoring path when this object belongs to an Editor document, including validation and Undo integration.

      Prefer this method for single writes — do not reach for an edit session or a command queue. When several writes must land as one Undo unit, wrap them in CubismFacade.authoringTransactions() instead of calling this method in a loop.

    • updateDefinition

      default void updateDefinition(ParameterDefinition definition)
      Atomically updates this parameter's Editor authoring definition.

      Backends that do not expose an Editor-native definition transaction fail explicitly rather than mutating detached runtime metadata.

      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - when the backend does not support parameter definition editing
